name: Scanner
scope: Self-serve CLI on your own machine. Static config + tool-schema analysis, JSON/SARIF/Markdown output, exit codes for CI.

name: Snapshot
scope: Human-reviewed report pack for one MCP deployment (up to 5 servers). Everything in Scanner, plus a board-ready summary (PDF-ready) with the operator's triage, prioritization, and a written reviewer note — the free CLI renders the raw pack; this tier is the judgment layer on top.
deliverables: Human triage: false positives struck, business context added

name: Deep Audit
scope: Scanner plus human review of one agent system (up to 15 servers, tool inventory, auth review, poisoning review). Fixed scope, fixed price.
